title: Sporting crowned LBP champions
description: Sporting - FC Porto 86-85 Sporting are the new LPB champions. They edged FC Porto in the decisive fifth game of the championship series to lift the trophy. The hosts took control from the first minutes by winning first half. But FC Porto won fourth quarter 22-18. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Jalen Riley (182-PG-93, college: ETSU) gave FC Porto an 85-83 lead with 17 seconds to go. Shakir Smith (185-PG-92, college: ASU) converted a layup at the other end to draw things even at 85. Garrett Nevels (188-G-92, college: Hawaii) missed a late jumper for FC Porto and Eric Anderson fouled Micah Downs (203-F-86, college: Gonzaga) with one second left in regulation. Micah Downs sank one free throw and sealed the win for the hosts. Sporting looked well-organized offensively handing out 22 assists. American players dominated the game. Forward Travante…
